gc.spitzhacke.title: Pickaxe as weapon
gc.spitzhacke.short: The middle mouse button swings any pickaxe like a mace; left click still mines.
gc.spitzhacke.body:
With the middle mouse button every pickaxe performs the main attack of a bronze mace: the same motion, three-hit combo, reach and [[valheim.stat.stamina|stamina]]. The damage is your pickaxe's, {gc_spitzhacke_pickaxe_enemy} against enemies and {gc_spitzhacke_pickaxe_ore} against ore and rock; the ore value normally stays below 100 % so the combat swing is no faster way to mine. Left click stays the normal mining swing.

The mod is part of GC Server ([[gc.kern.stufe|level]] 4 “GC light”), and the server and all players need it. While it runs, it counts with 1 % per boss for the automatic mode of [[gc.kern.bossscale|boss progression]].

gc.spitzhacke.pickaxe.title: Pickaxe: mace swing
gc.spitzhacke.pickaxe.short: Server rule: combat swing of the pickaxe on the middle mouse button. Off: pickaxes have no secondary attack again.
gc.spitzhacke.pickaxe.body:
This [[gc.serverrules|server rule]] is {gc_spitzhacke_pickaxe}; how the swing works is explained under [[gc.spitzhacke]]. The server sets the values too, so everyone plays with the same numbers:

- Damage against enemies: {gc_spitzhacke_pickaxe_enemy} of the pickaxe damage; the last hit of the combo counts double, as with a mace
- Damage against ore and rock: {gc_spitzhacke_pickaxe_ore}, the same for every hit of the combo
